evidence_quotes.agenda: 'unless you guys would like to share any specific concerns or what are you most worried about aside from the heavy wooden dresser, anything else?' — asked after the full inventory, but naturally follows a concern already dug into.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer flagged the heavy all-wood dresser unprompted; rep followed up with real specifics — 'how many movers did it take,' whether drawers come out to lighten it — genuine second-layer digging on the one concern raised.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'you are not [bound] by the estimate... if you guys are planning to take a car load or stage the boxes near the door... that's really helpful' covers window + self-prep together.

top_strength: Best rapport in the batch — engaged naturally with both partners on speakerphone, tracked a detailed 40-plus-item inventory without losing the thread, and closed with the customer thanking her by name.
coaching_note: Quid pro quo framing skips the time-box, and neither differentiator sheet nor the On-Time/Communication takeaway lands anywhere — a long, warm call like this one has plenty of room for both without feeling scripted.
